page_title: ACM 3-0 VER | AC Milan v Verona 28/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+3' Nicolas Valentini (Verona) meets a cross from the flank and pulls the trigger from the edge of the box, but the ball flies high over the bar. High, wide and not at all pretty.
90' We will have 3 min. of added time.
90' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Verona.
90' The ball is cleared after Abdou Harroui (Verona) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Verona get a corner.
87' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Gift Orban (Verona) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
86' Here is a change. Fikayo Tomori is going off and Massimiliano Allegri gives the last tactical orders to David Odogu (AC Milan).
84' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Al Musrati as he is replaced by Abdou Harroui (Verona).
83' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 11:6.
76' A substitution has been made. Alexis Saelemaekers is replaced by Zachary Athekame (AC Milan).
76' Massimiliano Allegri decides to make a substitution. Christian Pulisic will be replaced by Samuele Ricci (AC Milan).
75' Substitution. Suat Serdar (Verona) in, Daniel Oyegoke out.
73' The corner is swung in but Verona can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
71' Today's match ends for Ruben Loftus-Cheek who will be replaced by Youssouf Fofana (AC Milan).
70' Massimiliano Allegri has decided to substitute Luka Modric and he is replaced by Ardon Jashari (AC Milan).
66' Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Christian Pulisic.
65' Substitution. Domagoj Bradaric is replaced by Nicolas Valentini (Verona).
62' A mistimed header from the middle of the box by Victor Nelsson (Verona) goes well wide of the left post.
62' Verona have been awarded a corner kick.

62' Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) gets inside the box and tries to beat Lorenzo Montipo with a measured shot into the right side of the goal, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save.
61' Koni De Winter (AC Milan) gets himself onto the end of the corner, but his header is blocked.
61' Luka Modric (AC Milan) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
60' Adrien Rabiot (AC Milan) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger. The ball goes out of play. AC Milan are awarded a corner kick.
60' AC Milan failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

60' Koni De Winter (AC Milan) shows good awareness deep inside the box and jumps high to meet a perfect cross from the set piece. He steers a fine header goalwards, but finds the keeper prepared. No doubt about the wonderful save that he made. The linesman points to the corner flag, AC Milan are going to take it.
59' It seemed like Davide Bartesaghi (AC Milan) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
59' Antoine Bernede (Verona) commits a rough challenge and Michael Fabbri blows his whistle for a foul. AC Milan are awarded a free kick.
53' 3 - 0 Goal! Christopher Nkunku (AC Milan) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom left corner. He makes it 3:0.
53' Luka Modric (AC Milan) decided to surprise the goalkeeper with a quick shot from the edge of the box, but his effort came back off the left post!
48' 2 - 0 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Christopher Nkunku (AC Milan) low into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Lorenzo Montipo no chance!
48' Christopher Nkunku (AC Milan) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
47' Victor Nelsson (Verona) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation. The referee gives a penalty kick to AC Milan!!
46' Alberto Bertolini makes a switch. Amin Sarr is coming on in place of Daniel Mosquera (Verona) at the start of the second period.
46' Half-time substitution. Giovane (Verona) is replaced by Gift Orban.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45+1' 1 - 0 Goal! The resulting corner is whipped into the box and Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) buries the ball into the back of the net from a Adrien Rabiot knock down. 1:0.
45+1' Luka Modric (AC Milan) will deliver the corner kick.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
44' That was a poorly executed free kick from long distance. Davide Bartesaghi (AC Milan) was trying to produce a cross into the penalty area, but his effort sailed off the pitch.
43' Al Musrati (Verona) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
41' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from AC Milan comes to nothing.
41' Davide Bartesaghi (AC Milan) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger. The ball goes out of play and AC Milan have been awarded a corner kick.
41' We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 0:0.
35' A rebound sits up nicely for Cheikh Niasse (Verona) and he needs no second invitation to shoot from distance. The effort, however, slides well wide of the left post and out for a goal kick.
31' Luka Modric (AC Milan) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.

31' Adrien Rabiot (AC Milan) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort. The ball is out of play. AC Milan win a corner kick.
29' A cross from the corner kick arrives at the feet of Alexis Saelemaekers (AC Milan), giving him an opportunity to shoot. He misses completely, way over the bar.
28' Corner kick. Luka Modric (AC Milan) is ready to send the ball into the box.
28' Adrien Rabiot (AC Milan) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The referee signals a corner kick to AC Milan.
24' Michael Fabbri blows his whistle and it's Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
21' The corner from Luka Modric (AC Milan) is intercepted by Lorenzo Montipo.
20' Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players. AC Milan force their opponents to concede a corner.
19' Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) is able to continue to play.
19' Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
17' Daniel Oyegoke (Verona) sends a cross into the box, but Mike Maignan comes off his line to gather the ball.
15' Armel Bella-Kotchap (Verona) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
10' Antoine Bernede (Verona) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
9' Daniel Oyegoke (Verona) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
6' Good defending. Luka Modric (AC Milan) tries to find Christian Pulisic inside the box, but the pass is cut out.
4' Armel Bella-Kotchap (Verona) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are on the pitch and Verona will have the kick-off.
Michael Fabbri is the one to supervise the game today.
Show lineups The starting lineups for this match have been revealed.
